name: limit_fillet_on_a_double_edge
why: ENTRY E19, the «two candidates» branch. The plate and its copy moved by 100 touch on the face at x = 50: the vertical edge at (50, 30) is there TWICE, one per body, same length and same point. The fillet carries the uid read before the copy (E11); after the copy the edges are double, E11 is a 60 one, and the search by signature finds two equal ones. Choosing one would be guessing the body: refusal, «I do not choose».

steps._why_the_different_radius: 6 instead of the 8 of the twin: the refusal does not depend on the radius (entry F5).
